A parallel beam of monochromatic laser light is incident normally on a diffraction grating. When a certain number of slits, , are illuminated, the central principal maximum observed on a distant screen has intensity and angular width . The beam is then widened so that slits are illuminated, while the slit separation and wavelength remain unchanged. Which of the following correctly identifies the new intensity and the new angular width of the central principal maximum?

  1. Intensity and angular width
  2. Intensity and angular width
  3. Intensity and angular width
  4. Intensity and angular width
